pages.text: Northstar models many bodies, but only four have a surface to land on: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. Each has a surface and an orbit dimension. The rest are sky scenery in the atlas.
Gravity, temperature, air:$(li)Moon 1.6, -183 C, none$(li)Mars 3.71, -100 C, thin$(li)Mercury 3.7, -200 to 434 C, none$(li)Venus 8.87, 464 C, dense$(br)Orbits: no gravity, -270 C
pages.title: The numbers

pages.text: Lunar Plains, hills, crater fields and caves of ice, glowstone and asurine. Ores: titanium, zinc, copper, iron, gold, diamond, redstone, lapis, glowstone. Mobs: Moon Eel, Lunargrade, Snail. Abandoned lunar bases can be explored.
pages.title: The Moon
Moon Titanium Ore
pages.text: Smelt it directly into a Titanium Ingot. Titanium ore appears on all four worlds.

Martian dunes, highlands, peaks and caverns with crimsite and overgrown plants. Ores: titanium, iron, copper, zinc, gold, diamond, quartz, redstone. Mobs: Cobra, Devil Moth, Root Toad, Echo Worm. Martian iron and ash make Martian steel.
pages.title: Mars
Mars Titanium Ore
pages.text: Mars also has palms, tulips and Martian strawberry bushes.

Hills, basins, and icy or magmatic caverns, with a huge swing between day and night. Only world with tungsten ore. Also titanium, glowstone, lapis, gold, diamond. Mobs: Mercurian Raptor, Roach, Tortoise.
pages.title: Mercury
Mercury Tungsten Ore
pages.text: The only source of tungsten. Crushed raw tungsten is washed into nuggets.

Fungal forests, lava and sulfuric caverns under a very dense atmosphere. Ores: coal, quartz, glowstone, titanium and others. Mobs: Mimic, Scorpion, Stone Bull, Vulture. Sulfuric Acid kills if you swim in it.
pages.title: Venus
Venus Gravel
pages.text: Crushing it gives the most Rutile Concentrate of any source, for making titanium on Earth.

pages.title: Related
pages.text: Surviving there, the metals, ores and other dimensions.
